description: This PHP class 'DatabaseConnectionWrapper' manages database connection errors, provides error messages, and establishes connections with error handling, specifically for the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: DatabaseConnectionWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for managing database connections and errors, providing methods to check for errors, retrieve error messages, and establish connections with error handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the connection and error object.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Checks if there is an error present.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns a descriptive error message based on the exception or error code.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Returns the Throwable object associated with the error, if any.

methods.name: establishConnection
methods.description: Static method to establish a database connection using a callback, with PDO extension checks and error handling.
